unit_note: USD millions. Combined-schedule Trust Fund account: Special and Trust Fund Receipts + Program and Financing under one identification code 023-8115-0-7-602, following the shipped LoC -gift-trust and Tax Court -fees precedents. Blank cells (dotted-leader `.................`) not transcribed per project convention (blank != zero): 0198 cols 2-3, 1140 col 1, 5098 cols 2-3 (Receipts schedule) and 4100 col 1, 4101 cols 2-3 (P&F schedule) are omitted entirely. The closing identity 5099 = 2000 + 2101 + 5098 holds because 2101 (appropriations out of the fund) is printed as a negative.
